text: My dinner order took 85 minutes to arrive! The courier driver said there was a strike at the Dallas transit hub. Food was ice cold. I want an immediate full refund.
App showed delivery in 20 mins, now it says delayed by 60 mins. Cancelled order and ordering from QuickMart instead who has a 15% discount promo active.
Unable to find available delivery partner for 30 minutes in North Dallas. App kept searching then timed out.
Payment went through quickly, but tracking screen froze on Dispatching stage.
